description: This file defines API route handlers for managing notes, including listing, creating, fetching, updating, and deleting notes, utilizing FastAPI's routing and dependency injection features.

classes.name: NotesFlow
classes.description: Encapsulates the business logic for note operations, such as listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes.

methods.name: NotesFlow _get_flow(settings: Settings = Depends(get_settings))
methods.description: Dependency injection function that creates and returns a NotesFlow instance, ensuring database readiness.

methods.name: list[NoteRead] list_notes(flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all notes, returning a list of NoteRead objects.

methods.name: NoteRead create_note(payload: NoteCreate, flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new note with provided title and content.

methods.name: NoteRead get_note(note_id: int, flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: NoteRead update_note(note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow))
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing note identified by ID.

methods.name: DeleteResult delete_note(note_id: int, flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a note by its ID.

ctags.name: create_note
ctags.pattern: /^def create_note(payload: NoteCreate, flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow)) -> NoteRead:$/

ctags.name: delete_note
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_note(note_id: int, flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow)) -> DeleteResult:$/

ctags.name: get_note
ctags.pattern: /^def get_note(note_id: int, flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow)) -> NoteRead:$/

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^def update_note(note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow)) -> Note/
ctags.signature: (note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate, flow: NotesFlow = Depends(_get_flow))
